text:
**Top pick: ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 Magnetic Charging Station (Qi2.2, 25 W)**

It charges a compatible iPhone at up to 25 W, has a fan for cooling, and includes a fast Apple Watch pad and an AirPods pad. WIRED calls it the fastest 3-in-1 travel charger ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/)), and Macworld names it among the 25 W options ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html)).

- **Price:** $99.99 at ESR's US store (list $129.99). A code, PARTNER18, reportedly takes $17.99 off until 2026-12-31. The checkout has the final word ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand)).
- **Buy:** [ESR CryoBoost via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand)
- **Caveats:** 25 W applies only to the iPhone 17 series, iPhone 16 Pro Max, and iPhone 16 Plus on iOS 26. iPhone Air, 16, and 16 Pro get 20 W, and older iPhones get 15 W. A 15 W version costs $79.99 if you don't need 25 W ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand)).

Note that the Dealectric page is an affiliate site, and its discount and cart-test claims come from that site. I couldn't verify them independently.

**Other strong options**

- **Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable Wireless Charging Stand (Qi2 25W), $129.99.** This is the best pick if you want a tall desk stand. Macworld says it lifts the iPhone higher and adjusts more than rivals, but it weighs 399 g, so it's less travel-friendly ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html)). WIRED also lists it at $130 on Amazon ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/)).
- **Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand, $98 (10% off $109).** WIRED's "Best Overall" pick is a good value, but it charges the iPhone at only 15 W. It has a StandBy-friendly stand, and its base can fit AirPods Pro or an AirPods case with wireless charging ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)).
- **Nomad Stand One Max, $169.** This is the premium option, with 25 W for the iPhone and a glossy design. It doesn't include a power adapter, so you'll need a 40 W adapter (Nomad's is $25) ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)).
- **Nimble Podium 3-in-1, $130 on Amazon.** Choose this if you want devices to lie flat out of sight at night. It supports 25 W for the iPhone, but Apple Watch charging is slow ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)).

**Before you buy**

- Check that your AirPods case supports wireless charging. Older cases don't.
- Check that your iPhone supports 25 W. Only the iPhone 16 and 17 series do.
- Include a power adapter of at least 40–50 W. Some stands don't include one.

I can't link directly to the Satechi, Belkin, Nomad, or Nimble listings because the search results don't include their store URLs. The review links above are the closest sources. Search the product name at Amazon, Best Buy, or the brand's site to buy.
